entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this useless VeloBand tracker. This is ridiculous. I want my money back now.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the product. To get started, can I have your name and order number?
It's Mark Peterson. Order number is VF77819. Just process the refund.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling that up... I see you received the VeloBand GPS Tracker on December 22nd. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
There's no fault. I just don't like it. It's uncomfortable and the battery life is a joke. I want to return it.

I see. So it's not meeting your expectations. I understand, but since you've had it for over three weeks, I have to be upfront that our return policy can be quite strict. After so long, it's generally considered too late for a preference-based return.
Too late? I haven't even had it a month! What kind of garbage policy is that? This is unacceptable!

Sir, I understand your frustration, but the policy is in place for a reason. Once a wearable has been used for an extended period, we have to consider hygiene and sanitation risks. We can't resell an item like that.

I don't care about your sanitation problems! That's not my issue! I'm the customer! I want a refund or I'm putting a review on every single website that will absolutely destroy your company. Get me a manager, now!

I understand you wish to speak to a manager, but please allow me just one moment to review the specific policy details for your exact product. Sometimes different items have different terms. Can you just hold for 30 seconds while I confirm?
Fine. 30 seconds. This is your last chance before I light you guys up online.

Okay, thank you for your patience, Mark... I have the documentation here. And... actually, it looks like I was mistaken. I sincerely apologize. The VeloBand GPS Tracker, your model, is covered by our 90-day satisfaction guarantee.
What? So it's not too late?
That is correct. You are well within the 90-day window, so I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you. My apologies for the confusion, I was thinking of a different product line.
Oh. Well... okay then. You should have just said that from the start. So what do I need to do?

Not a problem at all, and I'll make sure to get this sorted immediately. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file for you now. Just package the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Does that sound good?
Yeah, that's fine. As long as I get my money back. Thank you.
You will. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mark?
No, that's it.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
